EXPECTED_SIGN: positive

EXPECTED_SIGN: negative

NAME: Dilution-Funded Dividend Strain

EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: Actual share growth verifies that outside equity claims increased while the firm continued distributing cash, avoiding reliance on gross issuance that may not translate into dilution. Weak residual cash makes the combination more indicative of externally supported payout rigidity than productive equity financing.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(ADD(prstkc, dvc), at), 1))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(TS_MAX(RATIO(oancf, at), 3), RATIO(oancf, at))))

EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
REASONING: Falling equity and debt issuance together indicate a transition toward internal funding, but only an improving cash trend validates that interpretation. Firms whose external financing contracts while cash quality deteriorates receive an adverse score because the same action may instead reflect lost capital-market access.

NAME: Post-Issuance Liquidity Repair
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(sstk, at), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(DELTA(RATIO(act, lct), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: Prior equity issuance is relatively favorable when followed by improved short-term liquidity coverage and adverse when liquidity continues to deteriorate.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
REASONING: The mechanism evaluates whether issued equity repairs the balance sheet rather than merely conditioning issuance on a pre-existing liquidity level. Lagging the financing action and using the subsequent current-ratio change creates distinct successful-recapitalization and failed-funding tails without an issuance gate.
